discourse.excerpt: This day is Deepavali, commemorating the victory of heavenly over hellish influences, of virtue over vice, as symbolised by the victory of Krishna-Sathyabhama over Narakasura, of the upward pull into Heaven and the drag down into Hell.
discourse.theme: Deepavali marks the inner victory of the divine over the demonic — won by constant remembrance of God.
discourse.title: A constable on each side

reflection: In this Deepavali discourse Swami paints life as a battlefield between the down-dragging and the raising impulses — and the victory goes to the one whose mind dwells constantly on God. His prescription is smarana: remembrance of the Name woven into every activity until it becomes the spring even of sleep. Pick one Name today and return to it quietly through the day, wherever you are. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 6, 11 Nov 1966)
seva_nudge: Light a lamp at home this evening and spend five quiet minutes in remembrance of the Lord's name.
